character_looks.role: 1770 年代法国沙龙女主人（虚构角色，historical 模式）
character_looks.prompt_image: 1770s French salon hostess, robe à la française in cream silk brocade, panniers widening the skirt sideways, decorated stomacher, Chantilly lace trim, fur muff, silk mule slippers, candlelit interior, historical mode
character_looks.prompt_negative: no modern shoes, no machine lace, no zippers or visible elastic, no anachronistic jewelry, no changed pannier width between shots, no symmetrical wide skirt front
character_looks.continuity_lock: 裙侧撑宽度固定在同场次内不变；后方箱褶垂坠位置、stomacher 暴露形状、手笼与鞋的颜色保持一致；发饰高度不得在镜头间变化
conflicts: 户外长途行走、奔跑与狭窄空间（panniers 与长裙限制动作）；现代都市场景；用普通裙撑替代 panniers 造成正面鼓起、轮廓错误；把该造型当作 1780s 后高腰新古典裙装。
